descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S27 「打入 'follow-up visit' / 'hospital day 3' / 'established patient' 的文字，从不把手动设的 New Admission 或 Consult 往下改（Save Note、Save & Extract，两个模式）」 Typed 'follow-up visit' / 'hospital day 3' / 'established patient' text never pushes a hand-set New Admission or Consult down (Save Note, Save & Extract, both contexts)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 The app never sets the status from dictation, in either direction (up to New Admission / Consult, or down to Follow-up): add-form dictation, pre-round Save Note, encounter Save & Extract, Quick Dicta …（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 5）
  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload …（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 1）
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3)（UAT TC-06；UAT 3.3；TFA-92584 AC 7）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Session fixture; the Hospital patient set by hand to Consult and the resident set by hand to New Admission at the start of the run

When Type the downgrade texts into the pre-round editor and press Save Note, then into encounter notes and press Save & Extract; reload; in both contexts

Then The Hospital patient stays Consult with Consult note pre-selected and the resident stays New Admission with SNF admission pre-selected after every save and after the reload

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT TC-06 'The app never sets status from dictation' + AC 5, the other direction from S13: #70's classifyEncounterType returns all three statuses, so a path that used it could also move a status down. Deterministic: one snapshot with the status moved is a Fail. Each text carries several downgrade phrasings. …
